# CANDIDATE: VOLUME_WEIGHTED_VWAP_PULLBACK

**Filed:** 2026-09-10  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger

## Hypothesis

Pullbacks to VWAP on high‑volume bars provide high‑probability continuation entries when the EMA ribbon (5‑EMA > 8‑EMA > 13‑EMA) is aligned and price is above the prior day’s high (long bias) or below the prior day’s low (short bias). The volume filter ensures institutional participation, increasing the likelihood of follow‑through.

## Mechanism

**Long entry:** price within 0.2% of VWAP, bar closing volume > 1.3× 20‑bar average volume, 5‑EMA > 8‑EMA > 13‑EMA, and price > prior day’s high.  
**Short entry:** mirror conditions with price < prior day’s low and bearish ribbon (5‑EMA < 8‑EMA < 13‑EMA).  
**Exit:** stop at the recent swing point opposite the trade direction; target at 1.5R or at the next named level (prior day high/low or VWAP extension).  
**Regime filter:** trade only between 10:30‑14:30 EST, VIX < 20, and avoid FOMC/major news windows.
